title: A Glass Between Them
summary: Inside the Mirage Club’s underground vault, Isabelle closes the heavy door and offers Kael a drink as if the smallest response can confirm the man she remembers.

panelPlan.text: Isabelle throws the brass deadbolt. Kael sits on a low velvet stool and starts unlacing a boot instead of moving for the door.
She sets a sweating glass on a copper table between them. Kael keeps both hands on his knees.
Condensation rings the copper. She nudges the glass closer. He never reaches for it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Isabelle
dialogueInline.text: You still wait for someone else to move first.

title: Locked from the Inside
summary: Isabelle demands an apology for a border collapse Kael never lived through. His refusal to perform the remembered man leaves her with fewer places to put the anger.

panelPlan.text: Isabelle stays between Kael and the vault door, composed until he gives her nothing to push against.
Kael finishes tying the boot. The silence gets longer than her prepared accusation.
A low vibration runs through the bunker as the solar flare builds outside. Dust shakes from the acoustic panels.

dialogueInline.speaker: Isabelle
dialogueInline.text: You left before the gate came down.

title: The Wall Gives an Answer
summary: In the service corridor outside the vault, Dylan and Eva search for a route before solar heat locks the bunker tighter. The wall answers with a fresh fracture rather than an explanation.

panelPlan.text: Dylan drags a brass compass edge along calcified salt while Eva holds a work light close to the seam.
The compass needle jitters. Eva crowds in; Dylan presses raw chalk into the crack and listens to the stone.
A sharp crack opens under the eastern passage. Dylan draws one hard chalk slash across that route and turns north.

title: Heat in the Door
summary: The flare heats the bunker hardware and the vault begins to bind. Outside, Dylan and Eva work the frame; inside, Kael stops treating the door as Isabelle’s argument and starts treating it as a jammed machine.

panelPlan.text: The brass deadbolt grows too hot to touch. Isabelle tries it once and jerks her hand away.
Outside the wall, Eva braces a pry bar while Dylan chips calcified salt from the frame.
Inside, Kael wraps his coat sleeve around the handle and leans into the door. For the first time, he and Isabelle are pushing in the same direction.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Push when I hit the frame.

title: The Silence Runs Out
summary: Once the door cracks open, Isabelle tries to close it again—not to trap Kael, but to keep the old story intact. Kael wedges a boot in the frame and makes the present impossible to ignore.

panelPlan.text: The vault door opens a handspan. Cold corridor air cuts across the warm room.
Isabelle grabs the handle and pulls back. Kael steps into reach and wedges his boot under the heavy edge.
She stops pulling. Her hands loosen from the handle while he leaves one cracked palm flat on the exterior panel.

title: Door Open
summary: The vault opens because the room and the woman inside it can no longer hold the same pressure. Kael leaves without taking ownership of the memory Isabelle put on him.

panelPlan.text: The brass slab finally swings into the corridor. Isabelle stays beside it, exhausted rather than defeated.
Kael passes Dylan and Eva in the service corridor. Eva looks back into the vault; Dylan checks the ceiling and keeps walking north.
Last panel: Isabelle sits at the copper table with the untouched glass. The wet ring remains after Kael is gone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: What did she think you did?
